label: alt-vanilla-canon-n16
_why: THE WALL-CLOCK REFERENCE, RE-MEASURED ALTERNATING (user-ruled 2026-10-21, after the October vanilla read x1.06-1.08 slower per unit of world than the summer vanilla on the same game version, FINDINGS F248: "It seems that the conclusion that same config gives same wall clock speed was premature. After the first round of polish later today, we'll launch an alternating set of configs, vanilla + mod, about n=16 for each, four days in total.") Vanilla and the canon alternate run by run, so any drift of the machine or the harness over the four days lands on both arms alike - the case CLAUDE.md names as the one legitimate use of interleaving (an extremely long, predetermined batch). It answers whether the canon is inside the +10% budget against a vanilla measured on the same days, and supersedes VANILLA_WALL_REF (lib_runs.mjs) as the wall-clock reference. The canon's register and ledger come from the same batch.
